en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small lakeside settlement. In the foreground stands a rectangular stone church with a steep metal roof and a square tower topped with an onion‑shaped dome and small spire. Tree‑lined paths and roads surround the church and a few adjacent buildings. On the right side of the image is a larger, plain multi‑storey building, likely a school or civic structure. Behind them lies a calm lake with reeds along the shore and forest and farmland beyond.
